rationale: Manjot's Ajath Infotech has spent over a decade building mobile and cross-platform solutions for healthcare, fintech, and e-commerce clients—domains where AI integration is increasingly critical. Artem's expertise in vision-language models, real-time inference, and ML systems could directly complement Ajath's service offerings, especially as Manjot looks to expand into vertical AI SaaS.
intro_message: Manjot Singh, meet Artem Yatsenko — his ML infrastructure and vision-language model expertise could be a natural fit as you explore AI capabilities for your consulting and product work.
